amends: transport_amendment.json (sha256 048e4745…, left unedited): only the pre-send reservation rule
consequence: a request of exactly the remaining cap is refused; with 512 KiB ranges and caps of 8 MiB, 64 MiB and 400 MiB this removes at most one chunk per window
frozen_before: the reservation repair; trigger: second source review (strict cap edge)
invariant: no ledger ever exceeds its cap, including when the server sends more than the requested range
reservation: the transport reads expected_length+1 bytes (the sentinel that detects an oversized body), so every attempt, including each retry, reserves expected_length+1 against the global, library and window caps before it is sent; a request whose reservation would exceed any remaining cap is refused unsent
